_comment: tower_arches: Ryan's TowerRock, cleaned exactly as tower.glb, with his eight rough windows filled back to solid wall and eight identical round-headed Greek arches cut in their place -- straight jambs, semicircular head, planar reveals splayed 10deg, one uniform sill line, plain string courses at the sill and the springing, a keystone at each crown. Column, crown and room are his. One textured material (packed 128x128 HellRock atlas), one UV set, no skin, no animation. TowerCollision rides in the .glb as a `-colonly` node: floor fan, a kerb to the sill band that the guard cannot jump (1.25 m, apex 1.11), one quad per pier, ceiling -- and nothing over the arches, so a shot goes straight out. Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and discards its mesh, which is why `surfaces` is 1.
